shared_elements: upright monolithic slab/pillar carved in relief
repeated row of similar motifs along the top
zoomorphic/anthropomorphic head with prominent eyes shown frontally or in profile
low-relief carving covering the whole face of the stone
justification: Both show an upright freestanding slab whose entire face is covered with relief imagery organised in stacked vertical registers, with a repeated row of similar motifs across the upper zone, and both include animal heads with emphasised eyes. But A depicts a sparse, highly schematic assemblage of isolated quadrupeds, birds and abstract signs floating on a plain ground, whereas B depicts a single dominant frontal standing human figure in elaborate costume, densely surrounded by ornament and rendered with much greater volumetric naturalism; the shared features are generic to carved standing stones rather than a specific shared scheme.
